Weather.Change.Unlock.title: Weather Change
Weather.Change.Unlock.description: Command the weather to change how you want. §dSneak §fto cycle between weather options

Weather.Change.title: Weather Change
first_tick_commands: execute if score @s EOP.Tempest.Weather matches 0 run weather clear
execute if score @s EOP.Tempest.Weather matches 1 run weather rain
execute if score @s EOP.Tempest.Weather matches 2 run weather thunder

Weather.Change.Switch.title: Weather Change
first_tick_commands: execute if score @s EOP.Tempest.Weather matches ..2 run scoreboard players add @s EOP.Tempest.Weather 1
execute if score @s EOP.Tempest.Weather matches 3 run scoreboard players set @s EOP.Tempest.Weather 0
execute if score @s EOP.Tempest.Weather matches 0 run title @s actionbar ["",{"text":"Clear Weather","color":"white"}]
execute if score @s EOP.Tempest.Weather matches 1 run title @s actionbar ["",{"text":"Rain","color":"blue"}]
execute if score @s EOP.Tempest.Weather matches 2 run title @s actionbar ["",{"text":"Thunder","color":"dark_blue"}]

Weather.Change.Switch2.title: Weather Change
first_tick_commands: execute if score @s EOP.Tempest.Weather matches ..5 run scoreboard players add @s EOP.Tempest.Weather 1
execute if score @s EOP.Tempest.Weather matches 6 run scoreboard players set @s EOP.Tempest.Weather 0
execute if score @s EOP.Tempest.Weather matches 0 run title @s actionbar ["",{"text":"Clear Weather","color":"white"}]
execute if score @s EOP.Tempest.Weather matches 1 run title @s actionbar ["",{"text":"Rain","color":"blue"}]
execute if score @s EOP.Tempest.Weather matches 2 run title @s actionbar ["",{"text":"Thunder","color":"dark_blue"}]
execute if score @s EOP.Tempest.Weather matches 3 run title @s actionbar ["",{"text":"Hail","color":"#d6fffd"}]
execute if score @s EOP.Tempest.Weather matches 4 run title @s actionbar ["",{"text":"Sandstorm","color":"#fadf91"}]
execute if score @s EOP.Tempest.Weather matches 5 run title @s actionbar ["",{"text":"Snowstorm","color":"white"}]

Tornado.Unlock.title: Wind Elemental
Tornado.Unlock.description: Manipulate the wind around you to form a wind elemental

commands: execute unless entity @s[tag=EOP.No.Destroy] run fill ~8 ~4 ~8 ~-8 ~-3 ~-8 air replace fire
execute unless entity @s[tag=EOP.No.Destroy] run fill ~8 ~4 ~8 ~-8 ~-3 ~-8 air replace torch
execute unless entity @s[tag=EOP.No.Destroy] run fill ~8 ~4 ~8 ~-8 ~-3 ~-8 air replace soul_fire
